meaningVi: sự tôn trọng, lòng kính trọng

definitionEn: the science that studies living things

definitionEn: the process of coming to live in another country

definitionEn: a large group of musicians who play together

definitionEn: to put power into a battery, or to ask for payment

collocations: nuclear power; nuclear energy; nuclear safety

definitionEn: a small room on a plane or ship for passengers
